    - name: Build staging variant into dist/staging
      env:
        VITE_GAS_ENDPOINT: "https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbwaNgQjqAJCOKt8ReWAE6uhEZzEBuRRsnRbRFsa16RpVQSs6KSRVCPNZnalOXZWy0CE/exec"
        VITE_STAGING: "1"
        VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID: ${{ vars.VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID }}
      run: |
        npm run build:staging
        mkdir -p dist/staging
        cp -r dist-staging/* dist/staging/
